_note: Annex A controls: 'mandatory' = always applicable for any ISMS, an exclusion would not be accepted by a certification auditor in practice. 'conditional' = applicable only when the stated basis is true; if not, exclude with the justification given. Clauses 4 to 10 are always mandatory.

conditional.5.13: Applicable if your classification scheme requires labels (e.g. Confidential marking on documents or data). Basis: classification policy and the volume of sensitive documents shared.
conditional.5.20: Applicable if suppliers access, process, store or transmit your information or provide IT services. Basis: vendor register. Nearly always applicable.
conditional.5.21: Applicable if your services depend on ICT suppliers or their sub-suppliers (cloud, SaaS, managed services). Basis: vendor register.
conditional.5.22: Applicable if you use external suppliers that affect information security. Basis: vendor register and contracts.
conditional.5.23: Applicable if you use cloud services (IaaS, PaaS or SaaS). Basis: asset and vendor inventory. Nearly always applicable.
conditional.5.34: Applicable if you process personal data (PII) of employees, customers or end users. Basis: data inventory and applicable privacy law.
conditional.6.7: Applicable if any personnel work remotely or from home. Basis: working arrangements and HR policy.
conditional.7.1: Applicable if you maintain offices or facilities holding information or equipment. If fully remote and cloud hosted, exclude or state inherited from the cloud infrastructure provider.
conditional.7.2: Applicable if you maintain offices or secure areas. If none, state inherited from the cloud infrastructure provider.
conditional.7.3: Applicable if you maintain offices, rooms or facilities. If none, state inherited from the cloud infrastructure provider.
conditional.7.4: Applicable if you maintain premises that need monitoring. If none, state inherited from the cloud infrastructure provider.
conditional.7.5: Applicable if you operate premises or on-site equipment exposed to physical and environmental threats. If cloud only: outsourced to the cloud infrastructure provider.
conditional.7.6: Applicable if you have secure areas (server room, records room). Basis: physical security assessment.
conditional.7.7: Applicable where personnel handle information at a physical workspace (office or home). Basis: working arrangements; nearly always applicable.
conditional.7.8: Applicable if you site equipment in your own premises. If cloud only: outsourced to the cloud infrastructure provider.
conditional.7.9: Applicable if company devices or information are used off-site (laptops, phones). Basis: asset inventory; nearly always applicable.
conditional.7.10: Applicable if storage media (USB, external disks, paper records) are used. Basis: media policy and MDM settings.
conditional.7.11: Applicable if you operate equipment that needs power or other utilities. If cloud only: outsourced to the cloud infrastructure provider.
conditional.7.12: Applicable if you own network or power cabling in premises. If cloud only: outsourced to the cloud infrastructure provider.
conditional.7.13: Applicable if you own and maintain equipment (servers, network devices, laptops). Basis: asset inventory.
conditional.7.14: Applicable if you own equipment or media that will be reused or disposed of. Basis: asset inventory.
conditional.8.11: Applicable if you process PII or other sensitive data that must be masked by law, contract or policy (e.g. in non-production or reports). Basis: data inventory and risk assessment.
conditional.8.12: Applicable based on risk of data leakage of Confidential or Restricted data. Basis: risk assessment and data classification.
conditional.8.19: Applicable if you operate systems where software can be installed (servers, endpoints). Basis: asset inventory.
conditional.8.21: Applicable if you use network services (internet, VPN, cloud networking, managed network). Basis: network architecture; nearly always applicable.
conditional.8.22: Applicable if you operate networks or cloud environments that can be segmented. Basis: network architecture; nearly always applicable for cloud workloads.
conditional.8.23: Applicable based on risk from personnel browsing external websites. Basis: risk assessment and endpoint controls.
conditional.8.25: Applicable if you develop or configure software or systems. Basis: whether you have an SDLC.
conditional.8.26: Applicable if you develop or acquire applications. Basis: SDLC and procurement.
conditional.8.27: Applicable if you design system architecture. Basis: SDLC.
conditional.8.28: Applicable if you write code. Basis: whether an engineering function exists.
conditional.8.29: Applicable if you develop software or make system changes that require testing. Basis: SDLC.
conditional.8.30: Applicable only if development is outsourced. If not: 'The organisation does not outsource development'.
conditional.8.31: Applicable if you develop or test software. Basis: SDLC and environments.
conditional.8.33: Applicable if you use test data. Basis: SDLC and data inventory.
conditional.8.34: Applicable if audits or tests are run against operational systems. Basis: audit programme and penetration testing.
